title: Hanasato Minori — Painful Honesty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Hanasato Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Welcome home, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm back, Samo!
Come here!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: So, were you able to meet with that landlady?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Actually, we'd already met her before.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that elderly lady you helped ended up being the landlady?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were all so surprised!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we get to rent that house!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
She must've recognized how hard you all work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, you're back.
Do you get that house? When are you moving?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We got the house, but I'm not moving out or anything. We're just using it as a place where we can practice and do our streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: But it's completely empty right now, yes? You're going to need furniture and all sorts of other things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we plan on discussing all that, including what we're going to use each room for!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then we'll start looking for furniture and... Oh, I'll be taking some stuff over from here.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: You'll also want to do some light cleaning before you officially move in since it's so difficult to move large pieces of furniture.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Remember how much cleaning we did before moving in?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh the memories.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, is there anything else I should keep in mind throughout this process?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Well...
You'll need to greet your neighbors at some point.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: You won't be living there, but you will be someone's new neighbors.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Greeting the neighbors...?
Oh, we're supposed to bring them soba!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right. I'm impressed.
But it may be better to also have towels or detergent ready in the event that they're allergic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ooh, Mom advice!
Lemme jot that down.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line: Wait, what do you say when you meet them...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Huh? “Hello, my name is Hanasato. I'm your new neighbor”...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka and the others will also be with me, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Hello! We're MORE MORE JUMP!
We're your new neighbors!” How's that?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that...?
Have you forgotten that you're idols?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, you're right! We should keep our identity a secret! That's something we'll have to discuss further...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: I guess being an idol just isn't that easy...

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong, Samo...?
You stopped wagging your tail.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line: He probably thinks you're leaving.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! No, Samo, I'm not going anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I won't be home as much since I'll be spending more of my time at the MORE MORE HOUSE... Which might mean us going on less walks together...

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
No, please don't frown like that...
Now I'm starting to feel really bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll do my best to wake up early to take you for your morning walks! I promise!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And on my days off, we can bring some of your toys and play lots and lots!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter how busy we get!
I'll come back to see you no matter what, Samo!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Samo!!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line: Relax, will you...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe.
